profile_text.body:
Coursera is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. It trades under the ticker COUR and its SEC filings identify it with CIK 0001651562. Its website describes it as an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, IBM, and Stanford. The company describes its certificates as providing job-ready skills and verifiable credentials, and points to career pathways in project management, UX design, data science, cybersecurity, and AI.

The site names a number of specific programs, among them the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. It also describes Coursera Plus as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates, which it presents as useful for learners completing multiple programs in a year.

On the legal side, the company's litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases. No lawsuits, no MCP servers, and no individual products are separately tracked in the material held here.
